ideas.title: Senior errand and grocery runner (hillside)
ideas.one_liner: Seniors and busy families pay a small standing fee for grocery pickups, pharmacy runs and post drops.
steps: Visit the 10 senior homes near you
Leave service cards at community centres
Offer $60 for a weekly 4-errand bundle, first errand free
Set fixed Tuesday and Friday run days
Text receipts for every purchase
Bundle same-day errands by area
Ask adult children to prepaid-book monthly
first_customers: Google Maps 4-star shops with unanswered reviews
pitfalls: Confirm mobility needs before entering homes
